name: PAZZ Marketplace

sourceLabel: Isolated local dev build, browser captures
demoScope: The operations workspace is an interface study with example data. The earlier quoting and guided-search screens come from an isolated development build; amounts and applicant details are synthetic, and estimates are illustrative.
engineeringNotes: Shared domain rules and recoverable document handoffs keep operating decisions consistent.
working: A quoting flow that turns a vehicle spec into a real-cost estimate — rent, estimated ISR deduction, creditable IVA — compared across terms
Claudio, a guided-search adviser that carries a confirmed budget into vehicle questions
A partner-application intake, gated behind a feature flag rather than live
remaining: Quoting screens show illustrative estimates from the earlier development fixture, not a partner offer.
The operations workspace is an interface study; it does not demonstrate production access or actions.

name: Maestro
purpose: A closer look at what's happening inside a music session.
description: A music-production workspace that turns session signals into inspectable evidence before you act on them.
demoScope: The local music workspace with synthetic session data. These September captures show the current interface; no real recording or connected DAW is used in this gallery.
engineeringNotes: Missing or stale audio evidence stays visible in the UI instead of being papered over with a confident guess.
working: Synthetic session registration and track ingest through the real local server
Masking analysis surfaced per track, with the finding kept visible in the UI
Mixer and spectrum views rendered by the real local application
remaining: These captures demonstrate the interface with synthetic telemetry, not live audio analysis or coaching.

name: Temper
purpose: Training, recovery and food, with room for more than one activity in a day.
description: A training week that fits real constraints before it becomes an active plan.
demoScope: Current Today and Train screens, plus yoga instructions. Synthetic health, food and training data; no HealthKit or WHOOP data is read for these captures.
engineeringNotes: Local drafts and commit-time validation keep an impossible schedule visible instead of silently starting it. Every plan revision carries who changed it and why, and a pending Coach proposal is shown as a proposal to accept or decline, never an already-applied change.
working: A planned workout alongside an independent Add activity action.
Illustrated exercise lists and individual exercise instructions.
remaining: A local development preview; public access is not available here.
